tagline: Come for the coffee. Stay for the feeling.
hero_text: Your local coffee shop in Blue Ridge, Georgia, serving handcrafted espresso, lattes, cold brew, matcha, chai, breakfast bites, lunch and more.
about_title: Made to feel like your favorite local spot.
about_text_1: Stevie G's is a locally owned coffee shop in Blue Ridge, Georgia serving hand crafted espresso, specialty lattes, cold brew, matcha, chai and breakfast bites and lunch made for busy mornings or a relaxing start to the day. .
about_text_2: Whether you're looking for breakfast in Blue ridge, your morning coffee, or an afternoon pick-me-up, Stevie G's is a welcoming local spot for great drinks, delicious food, and good company! We're here for early mornings, afternoon coffee runs, family stops, friend dates, and those “I just need a coffee” kind of days.
address: 389 West First Street, Blue Ridge, GA 30513
